## 2025-05-22 - CSS Injection in Chart Component
**Vulnerability:** Potential CSS injection via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` in the `ChartStyle` component. Maliciously crafted `id`, configuration keys, or color values could break out of the style block and inject arbitrary CSS.
**Learning:** Even internal-looking IDs (like those generated by `useId`) can be overridden via props. When using `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` to inject styles, all dynamic parts (selectors, variable names, and values) must be strictly sanitized. Attribute selectors should also be quoted to prevent breakout (e.g., `[data-chart="${id}"]`).
**Prevention:** Use a whitelist-based sanitization for IDs and keys (alphanumeric, dashes, underscores) and a blacklist-based sanitization for CSS values (blocking `; { } [ ] " < > \`).
